name: Zatomus
isnote: English Wikipedia says Late Triassic and classifies it as a rauisuchian; PBDB gives a Campanian age (Tar Heel Formation); check.
sum: Zatomus is a pseudosuchian named by Cope in 1871 from North Carolina, classified as a rauisuchian.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
